name: Bento Grid
description: Asymmetric grid of feature tiles (normal, wide, tall or large) with icon, title, description, optional background image and a call-to-action that slides in on hover. Good for home pages and app launchpads.
helpText: Each row is one tile. Map Span to a column returning normal, wide, tall or large to build the bento layout. On phones all tiles stack in one column.

attributes.name: Description
attributes.helpText: One or two sentences under the title.

attributes.name: Icon
attributes.helpText: Font APEX icon class, for example fa-line-chart.

attributes.name: Link URL
attributes.helpText: Target of the tile (developer-controlled URL, for example apex_page.get_url(p_page => 10)).

attributes.name: Link Label
attributes.helpText: Call-to-action text, for example Open. Shown on hover or focus (always on touch screens).

attributes.name: Span
attributes.helpText: Tile size: normal (1x1), wide (2x1), tall (1x2) or large (2x2). Unknown values render as normal.

attributes.name: Background Image URL
attributes.helpText: Optional decorative image shown faded at the top of the tile.
